title: Hint textarea
description: A text area that says what it can do (L15): a hint row under the text (“Gõ @ để nhắc nhà cung cấp · Gõ / để chèn mẫu”) and a suggestion list while the word at the caret starts with a trigger; the chosen item is inserted with a space after it.
when: A message or note where people mention a record (@ a supplier, a colleague) or insert a template or command (/).
A prompt box of a workspace or an AI tool with a few shortcuts.

instead.need: Pick one value from a list

a11y: A textbox with aria-autocomplete="list": while the list shows, aria-controls names the listbox and aria-activedescendant the current option. ↑ / ↓ move (wrapping), Enter or Tab inserts, Escape closes the list only (not a dialog around it); a polite status says how many suggestions there are.
Keys typed while an input method composes (Vietnamese Telex) are left alone. The hint row is the field's description. Named by its Field label or label.

examples.title: Mentions and templates
examples.description: Type @ or / at the start of a word.

notes: Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks (“tay nguyen” finds “Tây Nguyên”); at most six suggestions show.
